tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, and the ground of inputs, mobile table cards, preview boxes and discovery items inside a panel.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Surface of panels, modals, outline buttons and the mobile budget bar. Also the text colour of the toast, which sits on ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and panel (17.9:1 light, 16.3:1 dark). Also the toast ground and the affordability tick on rental bars.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Labels, hints, table headers, captions and the footer on bg and panel (4.55:1 on light bg, 4.76:1 on light panel, 6.96:1 on dark panel).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px dividers, panel, card and table borders, and the fill of condition tags. Decorative only (1.23:1 on panel): a control's border uses control-border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of inputs, selects, textareas, outline buttons, row buttons and file buttons, so each control's edge reads at 3:1 or more: 3.33:1 on light panel and 3.19:1 on light bg; 3.29:1 on dark panel and 3.47:1 on dark bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ceylon Emerald: primary buttons, links, active tabs, stat values, the 'IQ' in the wordmark, focus rings and the comfortable rental-bar fill (5.47:1 on light panel, 9.59:1 on dark panel).

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Electric Mint, the IQ spark: highlights and marks only. At 1.86:1 on light panel, never use it for text in the light theme.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Comfortable status (DTI up to 40%) as a fill or mark. Use ok-ink for text, because ok is 3.77:1 on light panel.

tokens.name: mid
tokens.usage: Stretching status (DTI over 40%, up to 50%) as a rental-bar fill. Use mid-ink for text, because mid is 3.19:1 on light panel.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Out of reach (DTI over 50%): bar fill and text, warnings, error messages and Remove actions (4.83:1 on light panel, 6.45:1 on dark panel).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Empty track of the rental bar.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill, such as the primary button (5.47:1 light, 9.59:1 dark).

tokens.name: badge-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the CBSL 2026 brand badge.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Text and border of the brand badge on badge-bg (6.73:1 light, 7.52:1 dark, 5.23:1 print).

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Comfortable status text on panel and bg (5.48:1 light, 9.29:1 dark).

tokens.name: mid-ink
tokens.usage: Stretching status text, the LTV warning and the grey-import badge on panel and tints (7.09:1 light, 10.69:1 dark).

tokens.name: print-head-ink
tokens.usage: Print only: table header text on the quotation, above the 1.5pt accent rule (10.35:1 on white).

tokens.name: print-rule
tokens.usage: Print only: 1px divider under each quotation table row.

tokens.name: print-field-bg
tokens.usage: Print only: fill of the loan-term inputs on the quotation, bordered in line. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Studio plate: pure white behind every vehicle photo, in every theme. In dark mode a 1px line border frames it.

tokens.name: plate-ink
tokens.usage: Caption and icon of the 'No photo' placeholder on the white plate, in every theme (4.76:1 on plate).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals.

tokens.name: callout-info-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of an informational callout. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: callout-info-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of an informational callout.

tokens.name: callout-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning callout. Text on it is bad.

tokens.name: callout-warn-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of a warning callout.

tokens.name: badge-official-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Official (agent warranty) route badge. Text on it is accent.

tokens.name: badge-grey-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Grey import route badge. Text on it is mid-ink.

tokens.name: ltv-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the '<60% down' LTV warning chip. Text on it is mid-ink.

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Wash on a selected discovery item, together with an accent border.

tokens.name: mark-tile
tokens.usage: Midnight Slate tile behind the Apex monogram in app icons, the favicon and the lockup badge. It is fixed and does not follow the theme.

tokens.name: mark-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest emerald, the end stop of the Apex left wing and the lockup gradients. Used in marks only.

tokens.name: mark-shade
tokens.usage: Start stop of the Apex badge's left wing. Used in marks only.

tokens.name: mark-teal
tokens.usage: Right wing of the solid brand mark in light mode. Used in marks only.

tokens.name: mark-teal-mid
tokens.usage: Spark gradient end and gauge hub. Used in marks only.

tokens.name: mark-spark
tokens.usage: IQ spark highlight in the marks.

tokens.name: mark-mint
tokens.usage: IQ spark on dark grounds in the solid mark and the dark favicon.

tokens.name: mark-amber
tokens.usage: Gauge logo only: the warm end of the dial arc and its indicator dot at the 40% DTI mark.

tokens.name: mark-tick
tokens.usage: Tick marks on the gauge logo.

tokens.name: mark-road
tokens.usage: Road gradient end in the Streamline logo.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Wordmark in the full lockup: 'Vahana' in ink and 'IQ' in accent.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: App title beside the 36px brand logo, once per page.

styles.name: h1-mobile
styles.usage: h1 at 480px and narrower.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Headline numbers in Your budget, in accent with tabular figures.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: Modal header title, in Title Case.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Panel titles, in Title Case.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Catalogue card vehicle name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select a vehicle, confirm its price and add it to your comparison.
styles.usage: Default text, table cells and inputs (inputs inherit font).

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: Smart vehicle lease and affordability discovery for Sri Lanka.
styles.usage: Header descriptor under the title in mute, max 70ch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels in ink, semibold and in sentence case, 4px above the field, so they stand apart from the muted hints below.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Callout body.

styles.name: foot
styles.usage: Footer disclaimer and meta links, max 80ch.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Leave empty to skip the affordability check
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, vehicle spec lines, legends and status tags.

styles.name: th
styles.usage: Table column headers in mute. They don't wrap.

styles.name: small-action
styles.usage: Small buttons (btn-sm) and inline link actions.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Catalogue price, always with tabular figures.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Catalogue category line in mute.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Brand badge, set in uppercase.

styles.name: route-badge
styles.usage: Callout badge (Official or Grey import route).

styles.name: lockup-tagline
styles.usage: Descriptor under the wordmark in the full lockup, uppercase, in mute.

styles.name: placeholder
styles.usage: Caption inside the empty studio plate.

spacing.note: Every padding, margin and gap step the stylesheet uses, named by size. Off-scale values (1px, 5px, 7px, 11px, 72px) stay literal.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of row buttons and icon buttons; brand badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field, and between a field and its hint.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap in the price editor, condition tag offset and small icon spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons (icon to label), between row actions and between tabs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, input vertical padding and button vertical padding; gap in header actions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, brand row gap and toast vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Grid gutters (terms, summary, tools), panel-head gap and the mobile panel padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, catalogue grid gap and the gap in the preview box.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels and the page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap below the header bar and the legend's column gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Modal padding and the page top padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Condition tags, LTV chips, rental-bar track and fill, the inline price input and discovery thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, row buttons and studio-plate images.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts, preview boxes and discovery items.

tokens.name: radius-logo
tokens.usage: The 36px header logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, catalogue cards, mobile table cards, status tags and the toast.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and route badges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The CBSL brand badge.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Spinner.

shadow.note: Surfaces are flat and use borders, not shadows. Only floating layers and the logo cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-logo
tokens.usage: Emerald glow under the 36px header logo.

tokens.name: shadow-budget-bar
tokens.usage: Upward shadow on the sticky mobile budget bar.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Undo toast.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialog.

tokens.name: shadow-price-focus
tokens.usage: Halo around the inline price editor while it is open.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of main.

tokens.name: modal-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a standard modal.

tokens.name: catalogue-modal-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the catalogue modal.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every control under pointer: coarse, and of catalogue buttons.

tokens.name: brand-logo
tokens.usage: Header logo tile size.

tokens.name: track-h
tokens.usage: Rental-bar track height. The tick overhangs it by 4px above and below.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: Vehicle row studio plate width (with thumb-h 70px).

tokens.name: thumb-h
tokens.usage: Vehicle row studio plate height.

tokens.name: thumb-w-sm
tokens.usage: Vehicle row plate width at 640px and narrower (with 60px height).

tokens.name: preview-w
tokens.usage: AI result preview plate width (with 88px height).

tokens.name: discovery-w
tokens.usage: Discovery checklist plate width (with 45px height).

tokens.name: opacity-placeholder
tokens.usage: The stroke icon in the 'No photo' studio-plate placeholder, above its caption.

tokens.name: opacity-glyph
tokens.usage: The ⇄ cycle glyph inside a condition tag.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons, such as a catalogue choice already in the comparison, pagination at either end, or Search while a search runs. They also show a not-allowed cursor and drop their hover change.

duration.note: Motion is short and functional; prefers-reduced-motion switches all of it off.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Modal fade in and out, and the discovery item's border on hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: The toast sliding up and away.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the spinner.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Fades, slides and border transitions. The spinner turns linearly.

tokens.name: z-budget-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky mobile budget bar.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast, which floats above modals.

breakpoint.note: Media queries can't read custom properties, so these values document the stylesheet's max-width queries.

tokens.name: bp-xs
tokens.usage: At this width and below: single-column catalogue, stacked AI search actions, h1-mobile and 12px panel padding.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: At this width and below: the filters toggle and sticky budget bar appear and thumbnails shrink to 96×60.

tokens.name: bp-catalogue
tokens.usage: At this width and below the catalogue grid has two columns.

tokens.name: bp-terms
tokens.usage: At this width and below the loan-terms grid has two columns.

tokens.name: bp-table
tokens.usage: At this width and below the comparison table becomes stacked cards with data-label captions.
